# Guidance on managing Cytokine Release Syndrome (CRS)

# CRS GRADE & DEFINING SYMPTOMS

# MANAGEMENT

# GRADE 1 CRS (Floor patients)

# Administer symptomatic treatment:

# Symptoms require symptomatic treatment only.

# Note: Acetaminophen order below placed with Bispecific medication order.

# If temperature >/=100.4 F or headache or rigors,

[Acetaminophen 650mg PO q6h prn Temp>/=100.4 F or headache or rigors](psjizid-acetamin-650mg-po-q6h-prn-temp-100-4-ha-rigors-crs)

# without hypotension or hypoxia.

Give and then NOTIFY Inpatient Medicine Provider.

# GRADE 2 CRS (Floor patients)

# In addition to Grade 1 treatment above:

# Symptoms require and respond to moderate intervention.

[Sodium Chloride 0.9% 1000 ml IV initial bolus over 2 hours for hypotension](psjizid-sodium-chloride-0-9-first-bolus-crs)

# -Fever greater than or equal to 100.4F

[Sodium Chloride 0.9% 1000 ml IV bolus over 2 hours \(2nd bolus for hypotension\)](psjizid-sodium-chloride-0-9-second-bolus-crs)

# -Hypoxia requiring oxygen therapy, AND/OR

# If hypotension not responsive to 2 liters NS, administer dexamethasone:

# -Hypotension responsive to fluids not requiring

[Dexamethasone 8MG IV x1 STAT for CRS Grade 2](psjzid-dexamethasone-8-mg-iv-x1-crs-grade-2)

# vasopressors.

# If patient not responding to interventions above, call a rapid response to

# transfer patient to ICU.

# Note: Tocilizumab may be given on 3D if delay in transferring patient to ICU.

# GRADE 3 AND 4 CRS (ICU patients)

# In addition to GRADE 2 treatment above:

# Severe symptoms defined as temperature >/=100.4F with:

[Transfer Patient to ICU](orz-set-pcm-transfer-to-micu)

# -Hemodynamic instability requiring a vasopressor (with or

# without vasopressin) OR

# Provider must order EACH dose of Tocilizumab as needed:

# -Worsening hypoxia or respiratory distress requiring high-flow

May repeat q8h if no improvement, no more than 3 doses/24hours and 4 doses total

# oxygen.

Maximum for each dose 800MG

Tocilizumab may be given with corticosteroids.

[Tocilizumab 8 MG/KG IV STAT DOSE#1 \(Grade 3-4 CRS\)](psjizid-tocilizumab-8mg-kg-iv-once-dose-1)

[Tocilizumab 8 MG/KG IV STAT DOSE#2 \(Grade 3-4 CRS\)](psjizid-tocilizumab-8mg-kg-iv-once-dose-2)

[Tocilizumab 8 MG/KG IV STAT DOSE#3 \(Grade 3-4 CRS\)](psjizid-tocilizumab-8mg-kg-iv-once-dose-3)

[Tocilizumab 8 MG/KG IV STAT DOSE#4 \(Grade 3-4 CRS\)](psjizid-tocilizumab-8mg-kg-iv-once-dose-4)

# VASOPRESSORS: use ICU specific orders/order sets

# Reference:

Lee D., et al. ASTCT Consensus Grading for Cytokine Release Syndrome

and Neurologic Toxicity Associated with Immune Effector Cells

Biology of Blood and Marrow Transplantation (2018) 25:625-638
Inpt: ORZID2 GMENU BISPECIFIC NEW CRS MONITORING
